candidates.statement: Gateway checkout POSTs return 502 because the downstream order service returns HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders; traces and logs show the gateway's client call to order failing with 500, propagating as 502 to /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Order-side root cause (db, payment, inventory) not observed; only gateway-side evidence available.

report.explanation: Gateway 502s on /v1/checkout correlate with downstream order service 500s on /v1/orders across traces and logs; gateway itself is healthy (/readyz 200). Root cause is bounded to order-service failure, but the specific order-side fault is not yet observed.
missing_evidence: Order service traces/logs showing why POST /v1/orders returns 500
Order service metrics for dependency operations (db, payment, inventory)
